title: SYNGENTA NK6607
subtitle: Syngenta NK6607 — "Makkey Ki Adalat" Experiential Rural Campaign
context:
• Syngenta holds a premier global footprint in agricultural biotechnology and high-yield seed development.
• Focused push on NK6607, a high-yielding hybrid corn seed engineered for drought resilience and high cob weight.
• Primary campaign deployment focused across the competitive rural agricultural belts of Maharashtra.
challenge:
• Deep-seated farmer skepticism driven by competing claims from local and multinational seed brands.
• Traditional rural marketing techniques (van campaigns, static handbills, dealer meetings) produced diminishing audience attention.
• Agronomic performance indicators—such as root anchorage and husk coverage—were difficult to explain through abstract technical terms.
• Low village gathering turnouts when events were openly promoted as corporate sales seminars.
concept: "Makkey Ki Adalat (Corn On Trial)." Subvert conventional rural demonstrations by staging a high-energy community courtroom drama modeled on popular televised courtroom formats. Put the seed itself in the witness box to answer charges of "disrupting the harvest with unprecedented yields."
execution: Theatrical Summons Pre-Buzz: Field teams dressed in formal court attire visited farming households across target villages, serving official mock summons requiring attendance at the village square.
Village Courtroom Staging: Transformed central community spaces into complete open-air courtrooms featuring a judge's bench, witness stand, defense tables, and procedural gavels.

Live Scripted Theater: Actors playing prosecuting counsels challenged the seed—personified by live pack-shot icon walkers—forcing the product to defend its root strength, cob size, and heat resilience.
Agronomic Demonstration Desks: Paired theatrical performances with technical demonstration zones, displaying root comparisons and grain density metrics alongside local agronomists.
Retailer Tie-In Closures: Established direct fulfillment counters with local village krishi kendras (agri-dealers), enabling farmers to place immediate booking orders post-show.

rows: High-capacity village audiences driven by curiosity-led judicial summons
High-retention dramatic courtroom metaphor explaining crop resilience
Direct-to-retail booking counters linking drama to immediate dealer sales

advantage: The Ekalavya Advantage: Rural activations require deep cultural empathy paired with structured narrative architecture to move community markets. Ekalavya Consulting builds branded experiential concepts that break through commercial fatigue, transforming ordinary technical demonstrations into high-converting regional events.

title: PRECISION INDUSTRIAL CONNECTIVITY

concept: "From Component Seller to Uptime Partner." Move the sales narrative away from component piece-prices toward complete cabinet reliability and assembly speed. execution: Application Narrative Architecture: Shift marketing from spec sheets to application-focused case summaries across high-risk operating environments: Solar Energy, Rail Transit, Marine Systems, and Hazardous ATEX Zones.

Proprietary Panel Configurator & BOM Tool: Build an intuitive web application where panel designers drag and drop terminal blocks and power modules onto virtual DIN rails, generating instant 3D schematics and automated Bill-of-Materials (BOM) for 1-click sample ordering.

Export-Grade Catalog & Packaging Modernization: Replace static PDFs with searchable digital libraries. Redesign physical packaging with high-contrast labeling, color-coded identification, and QR codes linking directly to CAD models and wiring diagrams.

Distributor Portal & Marketplace Cleanup: Establish a direct B2B partner portal with live stock levels, tiered volume pricing, and automated spec-sheet generation, while rationalizing listings on domestic B2B portals.

Account-Based Marketing & Expo Strategy: Execute targeted ABM outreach to Chief Electrical Engineers at leading panel builders and EPC contractors, paired with a live "Panel Speed Challenge" booth at Automation Expo.

Tiered Loyalty & Certification Ecosystem: Introduce a loyalty framework offering scan-and-earn tool rewards for workshop electricians and annual performance rebates and marketing funds for authorized distributors.

Technical Grassroots Initiatives:
  o Polytechnic Wiring Contests: Sponsor practical panel-wiring competitions across technical institutes to train upcoming engineers on the brand's modular connections.
